Cost: Double the original weapon’s Cost + 500eb ♦ Availability: Price Category is increased by one tier

BARGHEST are bullies, but they also employ expert gunsmiths that kit out their troops with the best streetbuilt iron around. Yet, producing new models is expensive, so usually they just tweak existing ones scrounged from around Dogtown. These modifications include depleted uranium ammo, more reliable parts, and a battery of accessories to ensure a lethal bite.

A Darkhound Variant Weapon becomes Standard Quality if not already so (Unless it is Excellent Quality, in which case it remains as such), gains up to 500eb worth of Attachments/Mods, and whenever it would ablate armor, it now ablates 1 additional SP. When buying Ammunition for a Darkhound Variant Weapon, its Cost is doubled and Price Category increased by one (e.g, Armor-Piercing is 200eb (Expensive)) and can only be used by the weapon it is purchased for. Melee Weapons cannot have Darkhound Variants.

NOTE: While the above text are the typical guidelines for Darkhound Variant Weapons, the following set of preexisting Darkhound Weapons may have extra modifications done to them that might tweak their functions and performance on a case-by-case basis.

EQ Sniper Rifle (w/ Infrared Nightvision Scope, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, & Tech Rebuild). Holds 4 rounds. This weapon’s Tech Rebuild can see simple target outlines through one layer of Thin or Thick Cover. While Charged, this weapon can fire through up to one layer of Thin or Thick Cover and, whenever it would ablate armor, ablates 1 additional SP. It also ablates 1 additional SP while uncharged whenever it would ablate armor (+1 SP Ablation Non-Charged, +2 SP Ablation Charged).

Variant of: Tsunami Arms Nekomata
Class: EQ Sniper Rifle
Range: Sniper Rifle
Pre-installed: Infrared Nightvision Scope, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog > Variants).
